Important

Important Notes

  • Weather-dependent: Flights may be delayed or rescheduled in poor weather. We build in flexibility.
  • Minimum passengers: Day safaris require 2+ pax for charter flights. Single supplement applies.
  • Licensing: Mainland safaris require a Tanzania mainland license (different from ZCT). We partner with fully licensed operators.
  • Best months: June–October (dry, migration) and December–March (calving season). April–May are wet; some camps close.
  • Health: Yellow fever certificate required if arriving from endemic country. Malaria prophylaxis recommended.
  • Baggage: Soft bags only, 15 kg limit on charter flights.
